title: neobalanocarpus heimii
intro: Neobalanocarpus heimii, commonly known as the Balau tree, is a species of plant in the family Dipterocarpaceae. It is a tropical evergreen tree native to Southeast Asia, valued for its timber and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Neobalanocarpus heimii include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Neobalanocarpus heimii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
